content.short: Raydium is a Solana-based AMM exchange with shared liquidity and a central order book for fast trading.
content.description: Raydium is a Solana-based automated market maker (AMM) and liquidity provider that powers the Solana DeFi ecosystem. Launched on February 21, 2021, Raydium shares liquidity with Serum, a Solana DEX, and taps into Serum’s central order book mechanism that mirrors traditional exchanges. This setup enables fast, low-fee trading of digital assets on Solana while relying on an order-book system for reliability, delivering an experience akin to conventional exchanges on a Solana-native platform.
